Berserker.description:

  • Induces a state of frenzy and increased aggression

  • Wound State/Facedown penalties to Skill or Stat checks are halved — No automation provided

  • User takes no Bonus Damage for any Critical Injury — No automation provided

  • +1 to Death Save while addicted

  • -2 Humanity Loss while addicted

Nymph Perfume.description:
Inhaled Pheromones that linger for 1 hour. Anyone who spends 3 rounds within 6m/yds of the source must make a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs} check or become confused for 1 hour.

Nasal Filters and other similar devices prevent this drug from being inhaled.

Piranha Smash.name: Piranha Smash
Piranha Smash.description:
Primary Effect Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • The user feels happy and satisfied, receiving a temporary modifier of +2 to Acting, Contortionist, Conversation, Dance, Human Perception, and Persuasion

Secondary Effect [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV9 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV9 Resist Torture/Drugs}

  • -2 to Acting, Contortionist, Conversation, Dance, Human Perception, and Persuasion while addicted.

GM will tell your when you crave more Smash. Roleplay accordingly.

Prime Time.name: Prime Time
Prime Time.description:
Primary Effect Dose last 4 Hours.

  • Sharpens your focus and resolve at the expense of your emotions.

  • +2 to COOL and WILL stats — User's max HP not affected

  • Roll [[/r 4d6 #Humanity Loss]]{4d6 Humanity Loss} — Humanity is returned when effect wears off

  • Cannot reduce Current Humanity below 0.

Secondary Effect [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs}

  • -1 Humanity Loss — Must be manually applied after every dose while addicted

  • -2 to COOL while addicted and not currently dosed

Sedative.name: Sedative
Sedative.description:
Applies the Unconscious condition for 4 hours on a willing target. Provides a +2 bonus to a Mechtech's Surgery check against targets dosed with this pharmaceutical.

Unwilling targets must make a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs} check. On a failure, the target is unconscious for 1 minute, and wakes upon taking damage or if awakened as an action by another actor.

+2 Surgery Bonus must be applied manually

Pharmaceuticals must be administered by a trained Medtech

Effects do not stack

Sixgun.name: Sixgun
Sixgun.description:
Primary Effect Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • +2 to Speed while Netrunning

  • -2 To MOVE & REF (Minimum 1)

  • User does not suffer the penalties of an Unsafe Jack Out unless forced to Jack Out by a program.

  • User can burn 1 Humanity for 1 additional NET Action once per turn.

Secondary Effect [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs}

  • -2 to Speed while Netrunning when Primary Effect is not active

  • +3 to any Initiative Rolls — If already in combat manually adjust initiative by +3.

Veritas.name: Veritas
Veritas.description:
Unwilling targets must make a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs} check. On a failure, the target suffers -5 to Acting, Concentration, Conversation, Deduction, Human Perception, and Persuasion Checks.
